related_questions.question: How to get a visa for Spain from the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: To obtain a Spanish visa from the USA, you will need to determine the type of visa you need (Schengen visa for short stays or a National visa for longer stays), complete the application form, gather necessary documents (including a valid passport, photos, proof of financial means, and travel insurance), schedule an appointment at a Spain Visa Application Center (like BLS International), attend the interview, and pay the visa fee.

list.snippet: Schengen Visa: For stays up to 90 days in a 180-day period for tourism, business, or visiting family.
National Visa: For stays longer than 90 days, typically for work, study, or residency.

list.title: 2. Complete the application form:
list.snippet: You can find the appropriate application form on the BLS International website.
Passport: Valid for at least six months beyond your intended stay, with at least two blank pages.
Photos: Two recent passport-sized photos meeting specific requirements (e.g., 2 x 2 inches, white background).
Proof of financial means: Bank statements, pay stubs, or other documentation demonstrating you can support yourself during your stay.
Travel insurance: Proof of medical insurance covering your stay in Spain.
Other documents: May include proof of accommodation (hotel bookings), round-trip tickets, itinerary, and a cover letter explaining the purpose of your visit.

list.title: 4. Schedule an appointment:
list.snippet: Visit the BLS International website for your region to schedule an appointment at the Spain Visa Application Center.

list.title: 5. Attend the interview:
list.snippet: You will need to appear in person at the application center to submit your application and attend an interview, if required.

list.title: 6. Pay the visa fee:
list.snippet: Fees vary depending on the visa type.

list.title: BLS International:

list.title: Appointment:

list.title: Processing time:
list.snippet: Allow sufficient time for processing, as it can take a minimum of 15 working days.

list.title: Supporting documents:
list.snippet: Provide all requested documents in the correct format to avoid delays.

list.title: Contact the consulate or BLS:
